items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: And we came to terms, and so I started writing her music, writing the show.

ctx.x: With Duke Ellington's band. And I asked him for more money. He said he wasn't going to give me any more money, so I quit. I came back to New York. Al Sears quit the band also that same time I did, and we come back to New York.

And I was fooling around, and somebody says, hey, Norma Miller wants to see you. And I said, what's Norma And he said, -- whoever was the fellow that told me, he says, he's got a show and he needs somebody to arrange the music. So then I got in touch with her and we -- she took me down to her lawyer or the guy who was producing the thing. And we came to terms, and so I started writing her music, writing the show.
